anomalies.observed: R60 pin 2 is connected to the ESTOP_OUT net instead of GND. D30 pin 4 (A2) is also on ESTOP_OUT, while D30 pin 2 (K2) connects through R60 back to ESTOP_OUT, forming a closed loop with no return path to ground.
anomalies.expected: R60 pin 2 should connect to GND, so that D30's second LED is between ESTOP_OUT and GND and illuminates when ESTOP_OUT is asserted (active high).
anomalies.impact: The second channel of dual LED D30 (likely the ESTOP_OUT indicator) never illuminates because its anode and cathode return to the same net, so the e-stop output has no visual indication.

parsed.summary: The design contains a wiring error in the e-stop indicator circuit: R60 pin 2 is tied to ESTOP_OUT instead of GND, so the second LED of D30 cannot light. No other clear anomalies were found.
